Retrieval requires three words, uses all terms, and preserves exact rows
Native tool tokens do not count as conversational tokens
Every turn retrieves then responds; only second output is speech and the next turn starts fresh

Malformed native output remains evidence and produces no completed turn
100 synthetic replies alternate 50/50 and commit CSV before each next call
GPU seed still produces 50/50 with the seed excluded
